title: For EU Markets: Product Attribute Changes and New Category Openings Notice
content:
# **What is changing?** To strengthen compliance governance, improve product information completeness, and manage category openings in EU markets, TikTok Shop will roll out 7 updates related to product attributes and category openings. 4 items involve attribute collection or mandatory field adjustments, and 3 items are new category opening notices. Please pay close attention to attribute items that require action, and complete adaptation in the listing pipeline, product templates, and API submission capabilities before the planned effective time. # **Changes overview** | Item | Change topic | Type | Attributes / Categories | Scope | Planned timeline | Action required | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | Toy / maternity & baby category attribute coverage | Attribute change | Recommended Age, Material Feature, Electrical Product | EU toy / maternity & baby categories | Live as of July 28, 2026. ISVs must update systems and sellers must fill in the attribute by Sept 30, 2026 (enforcement starts Oct 1). | Update field collection and submission capabilities
Use [GET Attributes ](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-attributes-202309) | | 2 | Electronics power mode and battery attribute coverage | Attribute change | Power Mode, Contains Batteries or Cells? | EU Electronics / EEE categories | Live as of July 21, 2026. ISVs must update systems and sellers must fill in the attribute by Sept 30, 2026 (enforcement starts Oct 1). | Update field collection and submission capabilities
Use [GET Attributes ](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-attributes-202309) | | 3
| Traceability attributes becoming mandatory | Attribute change | Model, Batch Number | Electronics / EEE and Textile categories | Live. ISVs must update systems and sellers must fill in the attribute by Sept 30, 2026 (enforcement starts Oct 1). | Ensure model / batch information is populated during listing
Use [GET Attributes ](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-attributes-202309) | | 4
| EU GARAN guarantee attributes rollout | Attribute change | Whether a voluntary durability commercial guarantee of at least 2 years is offered, Guarantee Duration, Producer Name, Model Identifier | Applicable EU categories | Live. ISVs must update systems and sellers must fill in the attribute by Sept 27, 2026 (enforcement starts Septemeber 28). | Add field collection, validation, and pass-through capabilities
Use [GET Attributes ](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-attributes-202309) | | 5 | Household Cleaners / CLP & Biocides category opening | New category | Household Cleaners, CLP, Biocide categories | IE, ES, IT, FR | Launched/Available | New category notice, refresh category list. [Use GET Categories](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-categories-202309) | | 6 | Solar Panels category opening | New category | Solar Panels | EU | Launched/Available | New category notice, refresh category list. [Use GET Categories](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-categories-202309) | | 7 | Luxury Watches category opening and attribute preparation | New category | Pre-owned Luxury Watches | IT | Launched/Available | New category notice, refresh category list. [Use GET Categories](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-categories-202309) | # **Which markets are affected?** * EU markets are the primary scope of this notice. * Attribute change items are driven by EU compliance and product information requirements. Some logic may also apply to UK or other configured markets; the final scope depends on the actual category selected and category rules. # **Who is affected?** * Sellers who publish, edit, or bulk import products in the relevant EU markets. * ISVs, service providers, and technical teams that support apps that list products through API. * Operations, product, and support teams that rely on product attributes for compliance validation, qualification cascading, or label rendering. # **What action is required?** 1. **For Items 1 - 4:** Add newly introduced or newly mandatory attribute fields to the product listing, editing, bulk import, and API interfaces, and validate them before submission. Complete system adaptation before enforcement dates above to avoid product creation or editing failures after the exemption ends. 2. **For Items 5 - 7:** These items are new category opening notices; as notifications, refresh the category list to ensure sellers can use these categories. 3. **General recommendation:** Please update product templates, internal SOPs, and customer service / operations scripts to make sure frontline teams know which fields need to be populated and which items are only category opening notices.
